en: Nah... Truth is, you and my gramps are still kicking some serious ass for your age.
Plus, you guys got this cool, rough edge that only comes with growing older.
What happened to all that trash talk about you being strong and good looking?
Maybe this'll explain it. Got a minute?
Clock's ticking.
I never knew what my gramps looked like when I was a kid. My dad didn't want anything to do with him.
That's because Gramps was a homeless loser.
But I was kind of a wimpy little kid. Kids who were older and bigger would always pick on me.
You were bullied when you were a kid?
Yeah, pretty sad, right? So I ended up seeking out my gramps for help. Had him teach me the Komaki style.
Long story short, I became the kickass fighter I am today. Gramps even said I had potential.
But when I decided to go get my revenge against those bullies, my gramps stopped me.
He told me, "Technique alone is not enough. You must also have a strong heart."
Words of wisdom.
Yeah? Well, I don't get it. Guess I'm really that dumb.
The Komaki techniques are really powerful. I want to use them to stop bad guys. That's the right thing to do, isn't it?
Opening a dojo and practicing together all friendly-like... Is that what the Komaki style is for?
The right thing, huh? That's a tough one.
It's easy to beat down punks who get on your nerves, but that's not necessarily the right thing to do.
The people you call bad guys might be doing what they think is right, too. Ever think of that?
I get what you're saying, but...
Oh, man! I'm so confused! And the stuff old dudes like you say just makes it worse!
The Komaki techniques are all I've got. I don't have anything else I can count on.
I've got one more thing to teach you. It's something I came up with myself. Come on back when you're ready.
After that, your training will be complete, and we can finally duke it out for keeps.
Nice! You nailed that one!
Yeah. That one's bound to come in handy.
You learned <Color:9>Ultimate Essence (Climax Heat)<Color:Default>.
I thought you were hopeless at first. I didn't think you'd make it this far.
That's a pretty backhanded compliment.
You got me there, old man.
But really, you're turning out a lot better than I thought you'd be.
Heh. Thanks, I guess.
No problem. Now you should be good enough that I don't have to hold back anymore.
So now we can face off for real.
What's the matter? You scared?
You know how you noticed I'd gotten rusty? Well, I noticed something, too.
Oh, this should be good. Let's hear it!
Relax. I just noticed that you're not at your full fighting potential, either.
Huh? What're you babbling about, old man?
I'm not one to talk, but your moves are more about violence than martial arts.
If Master Komaki taught you himself, your form would be cleaner, and you'd put your heart and soul into each technique.
I don't sense that in your fighting, even assuming that you're holding back.
Are you just trying to piss me off now?
Fine with me. That load of bullshit's given me even more motivation to kick your ass.
I don't mind taking you on, but you're trying to prove something, not just fight.
Just say what you mean already, old man.
I'm not sure why, but...
Something tells me you should go see your grandfather.
I get that you want to be the best and the strongest. I get that you think looks are a part of that.
But it looks to me like you're just spinning your wheels.
You trying to piss me off again?
You're not trying to surpass your grandfather. You want to impress him.
What the hell're you talking about!?
By your reaction, I'd say I hit a nerve.
Under all that machismo, you're just a little kid looking for a little affirmation.
You son of a bitch! You think I'm gonna sit here and take that shit from you!?
I don't care what that old geezer thinks. I already know I'm a total badass.
Screw you, old man! Who do you think you are, anyway?
I'm just pointing out the obvious. You decide what you need to do. But remember...
The more you resort to violence, the further you stray from your grandfather's path.
That's all I have to say. Take some time to think about it.
Screw this, we'll settle this next time! You'll pay for dissing me!
Now get your ugly ass out of my face!
You actually came. Thought I might never see you again by the way you acted.
Just felt like stopping by.
Yeah? Well, you're here, so that's all that matters.
Let's get down to business. I noticed something when I watched you fight.
You use Komaki techniques here and there. Did you learn them from Sotaro Komaki?
You'd rather not say? There's no point in hiding it, but whatever.
Sotaro Komaki's my grandpa. I learned the Komaki style from him.
You probably noticed when we fought that we use some of the same moves.
I was surprised at first, but I guess there are more of us than you'd think.
So that's why you approached me.
Yeah, but that's not really the point.
I won't ask you how you know my gramps's techniques if you don't want to talk about it.
But I hardly ever run into one of his students, especially one that looks as tough as you. That's why I couldn't let it go.
And that's why I need to beat the shit out of you. Sorry, but that's just the way it is.
Gramps thought you were good enough for him to train, but the way you are now, there's no point in beating you.
I'm going to train your rusty ass till you're in top form and can give me the fight I really want.
Then I'll beat you down with all I've got.
I get it. Then you'll feel like you've beaten your grandfather, too.
But if you want to fight him, just do it man to man instead of being so roundabout with it.
Man, you don't know what you're talking about.
I could beat that old geezer with one hand tied behind my back. This is about so much more than that.
What's it about, then?
You really want to know? I get the feeling you couldn't care less.
But if it turns out to be worth my time getting you back into shape, then I'll let you in on what I'm after.
But if those lowlifes around town still give you a run for your money, you've got a ways to go.
Using one big move after another isn't always the answer. Be more strategic in your battles.

You can prevent the activation of Heat Actions by holding down <Action:Battle_Center_Camera@Combat>. Do this when you want to raise the Heat Gauge or take greater control of how you use your techniques.
But I don't suppose I need to tell you that. You probably already figured it out yourself.
Anyway, come see me whenever you feel like practicing. I'll smack you back into shape.
If I'm not here, just come find me around town. I like to keep it casual like that.
Hey, old man.
You sound down in the dumps. What's up?
I thought about what you said.
And as much as I hate to admit it, I think you were right.
I wanted my gramps to see me as a real man. That's all I've ever wanted.
But I got caught up in proving how strong I was. That's why my Komaki techniques just turned into violence.
Wait, are you actually admitting you were wrong?
What? No! I don't second-guess myself, and I never have regrets.
Right...
It's just, as long as my fighting is nothing but violence, I'll never surpass my gramps, and I won't be the man I want to be.
I have to open my eyes.
I'm going to go slug it out with my gramps and face reality, just like you said.
And if nothing changes, then I guess I'm not really all that.
You're finally sounding like a man.
Man, there you go again offering a compliment like you're better than me or something.
Heh.
Tsk, whatever.
Time for me to bounce. I'm off to Kamurocho, and I won't be back till I'm good and ready.
Okay, good luck.
I'm going to need more help than "good luck," old man.
Well, you were the one who told me to go see my gramps, so...
You're not suggesting⑬
That's exactly what I'm suggesting. I mean, how could I possibly afford a trip to Kamurocho?
It's your duty as an adult to help young people like me chase their dreams.
Unbelievable...
Hey, old man. You decide to fund my trip yet?
(30,000 yen should be enough to get him to Tokyo. Hmm...)
Don't be a spoiled brat. Get the money yourself.
Man, really? Man, it's not like this is about the money or anything.
You were pushing me to go see Gramps, but I wasn't sure if you really cared or if you were just saying it.
I guess now I know.
Sorry, I'm a little short right now. Maybe next time.
I'll be waiting right here. Not like I have a choice, anyway.
Sweet. I'll put it to good use.
Is that your way of saying thank you?
Hey, I may look and act cool, and that's because I am, but being grateful is a cool thing to do, too.
Look, here's the deal.
I won't forget this. And I'm going to pay you back someday.
But not until I beat my gramps and prove that I'm the strongest of all.
Hah. Well, I'll look forward to that day.
I won't disappoint! Anyway, I'm off. See you!
I have a question, Master!
Okay, let's hear it.
Is it true that nothing is certain?
Excellent question. I will answer it by saying this...
I love curry! That is the only thing that is certain!
Is it true that having someone special in your life makes you stronger?
If you have time to find someone special, use it to do squats! That's guaranteed to make you stronger!
Everyone puts a different kind of meat in curry. Which one's the right one?
No matter what you put in curry, it still tastes like curry! Nothing you add can change that!
My feet have been really stinky lately. What should I do?
Wash between your toes! Most people only wash the bottom and sides of their feet!
I waste money like crazy. How can I become more frugal?
Donate all your money to charity! Then you won't have to worry about wasting it anymore!
Aren't they overdoing it with all the "Now serving chilled ramen" signs around town?
The real question is why chilled ramen is almost always the same! I prefer mine with sesame seed sauce!
There are many theories about why the dinosaurs went extinct, but what do you think, Master?
I am the one who made the dinosaurs go extinct!
When I go out with friends, they always want to split the check evenly. The problem is I don't drink, so I feel cheated. What should I do?
Make up the difference by pigging out! And focus on the most expensive dishes!
I always feel kind of sad as winter nears. How about you, Master?
When I dress up as Santa, children run the other way! It really bums me out!
Maybe it's because of all the terrorism and war around the world. Is there anything we can do about it?
Don't forget that feeling! And make sure not to fight! If everyone did that, violence would vanish from the world!
I understand! Thank you, Master!
What's wrong with you!? That was one big, epic fail!
Make sure you're prepared in both body and spirit before you try again!
All right, dismissed!
Okay. You pass!
Here's a reward. There's nothing better to soothe your post-training aches.
You got a <Color:8>Staminan XX<Color:Default>.
Repeating your training is a magnificent thing. Don't you ever forget that!
Watching you reminds me of that one time...
I ran alongside my war buddy's fighter plane to hand him his wallet after he forgot it.
There's no way you could run that fast! Besides, who needs a wallet to fly a warplane?
So, what did you learn this time?
Hmm... I'm more nimble now, and it feels like my sense of balance has improved.
You learned <Color:9>Slash Kick Plus<Color:Default>.
Your fighting style is based on kicking, so you must train both your legs equally. Don't focus solely on your dominant one.
Remember that every time you go into battle!
I was out of ammo and about to die when one of my wisdom teeth fell out. So, I loaded it in and blew away my enemy. That was one close shave!
I've never heard of wisdom teeth suddenly falling out like that. And how could you possibly fire a tooth from a gun, anyway?
Hmm... I feel like I can literally dodge bullets after being shot at like that.
You learned <Color:9>Quickstep Attack<Color:Default>.
Dodging won't take out your enemy, so it's important to attack at the same time.
After everyone in camp went to sleep, my war buddy and I secretly enjoyed a late night snack of hardtack.
You sound like a couple of kids on a campout! But memories like that can put a smile on your face, I guess.
I guess actual fighting's the best training. I thought of a move that can really turn the tables in a fight.
